Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion의 글로벌 웹 기반 플랫폼과 서비스의 백엔드 개발에 참여할 동료를 모집합니다. 본 포지션은 CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠 관리 및 협업 플랫폼에 직접 참여하여, 고도화된 백엔드 서비스를 설계하고 구현하는 중요한 역할을 수행합니다. 플랫폼 서비스의 안정성과 확장성을 책임지는 백엔드 API 서버와 각종 Worker 서비스의 개발 및 구현을 담당하게 됩니다. 나아가 서비스 운영에 필수적인 검색 데이터 연동, 그리고 대용량 데이터 처리를 위한 다양한 백엔드 기술 통합을 경험하고 주도합니다. 최종적으로는 프론트엔드를 포함한 다양한 유관 부서와의 긴밀한 협업을 통해, 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 글로벌 플랫폼 서비스의 전반적인 기능을 설계하고 완성도 높은 제품을 만들어나갈 기회가 주어집니다. 기술 스택 (Tech Stack) Core: Kotlin/JAVA, Spring WebFlux/WebMVC, Coroutines Infra: Azure, AWS, K8s(optional), Docker AI Tools: Claude, Gemini Data: MS-SQL, Redis Monitoring: Datadog Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [과제 전형] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] *이력서를 제출하실 때 본인의 업무 이력과 역할, 그리고 그 과정에서 어떠한 부분을 느끼고 성장했는지 적어 주시면 좋습니다. *2차 인터뷰 조율 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크 요청을 드리고 있습니다. *각 전형에 대한 상세 안내는 메일을 통해 안내해 드리고 있습니다.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashion is redefining the future of apparel through cutting-edge 3D clothing simulation technology—powering the entire fashion lifecycle from concept and design to production, marketing, fitting, and styling. Since 2009, CLO has been building a dynamic digital fashion ecosystem, driven by its industry-leading simulation algorithms that blend the physical and virtual worlds of clothing. Our suite of tools—including CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny—streamlines every stage of the garment creation process, while platforms like CLO-SET and CONNECT enable seamless collaboration, content management, and digital asset workflows. Through smart tagging technology, CLO also links physical and digital garments, creating an integrated and intelligent fashion infrastructure built for the future of design and sustainability. CLO Virtual Fashion, a global leader in digital fashion innovation, operates across 16 offices in 13 countries—including key hubs in Asia, North America, Europe, and South America. As the demand for immersive, tech-driven fashion solutions grows, CLO continues to expand its global footprint, powered by a rapidly growing international user base and a future-focused vision. jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashion is the creator of CLO and Marvelous Designer, the top 3D garment design programs used in fashion, film, and game development. With over two decades of research and development in accurate garment simulation, CLO Virtual Fashion's mission is to empower users at every step of the garment journey, from concept to design, manufacturing to marketing, and fitting to styling. In addition to 3D garment design software, CLO Virtual Fashion's products include CLO-SET (a digital asset management and collaboration platform), CONNECT (a digital fashion hub and marketplace), and consumer-facing solutions such as e-commerce virtual fittings. Founded in 2009, CLO's interconnected and ever-growing product ecosystem is built to power the future of everything related to garments. CLO Virtual Fashion currently has 14 offices located in 12 countries across North America, Asia, Europe, and South America, and continues to expand to serve users around the globe. Position Overview We are seeking an Employee Experience Manager to join our fast-moving CLO Virtual Fashion team. While aligning with the Global People & Culture Team, you will be the Culture Evangelist who helps employees align with the company’s mission & vision. Simultaneously, while maintaining seamless communication with the many stakeholders, you need to engage to increase operational efficiencies and create an environment where employees can focus on their own roles and responsibilities.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist, Computational Pathology
jobs.description_text: About Us: Artera is an artificial intelligence company dedicated to transforming cancer care. We’ve developed foundation models that analyze clinical and pathology data, generating actionable insights that guide therapy selection and improve outcomes for cancer patients. By continuously improving these models, we aim to uncover the biological mechanisms driving cancer progression. Build ML that changes how cancer is treated. Most medical AI stops with a publication. Our AI models guide treatment decisions today. Artera’s AI-driven prostate test is standard-of-care in the US and cancer patients in all 50 states are using our models to help make decisions about their therapy. While we started in prostate cancer, we’ve grown into a multi-cancer platform with more disease settings in development. You'll help build what's next. The role At Artera, we’re making ML development agent-first. You won’t spend your days hand-writing training loops, tuning hyperparameters in notebooks, or babysitting individual runs. Instead, you’ll design, direct, and evaluate autonomous research agents that propose hypotheses, write and execute experiments, and train models autonomously. You’ll be tasked with answering specific scientific questions: which patients can safely forgo aggressive treatment or inferring molecular traits from routine digital slides and your job will be to decide what’s worth investigating and which research directions merit investment. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Scientist, Computational Pathology
jobs.description_text: As a senior or staff scientist, you'll own an AI biomarker end to end, from problem framing with our product, medical, and biostatistics partners through validation, regulatory submission, and production. You'll set technical direction for the scientists and engineers around you, and take on the hardest cross-cutting problems in our field: making models hold up across scanners, stains, and sites so a patient’s result doesn’t depend on the scanner, lab, or stain behind their slide, uncovering what our models have learned about tumor biology, and building the next generation of our pathology foundation models. At the Staff level, you'll also set direction across programs and help shape the AI roadmap with leadership.

You will partner with Supply Chain, Sales Operations, and FP&A, and your margin analysis will reach the executive team. You inherit a working foundation and a lot of room to make it better.A few things make this role unusual. Eko does not run a factory: devices are built by contract manufacturers and bought as finished goods, so cost is purchase price plus landed cost, and inventory sits with partners we cannot walk into. Hardware is sold alongside subscription software, so the margin story is blended. And this is a hands-on manager role with no direct reports to start: you provide review oversight to our offshore transactional team while personally owning the higher-judgment accounting, reconciliations, close, and conclusions. For a researcher this is unusually open ground - not one model family, but several, on the same data: Recommendation and retrieval. Game theory and mechanism design. Auction formats, bidding behaviour, incentives, and competitive dynamics between real counterparties. Combinatorial optimisation. Award allocation under volume, capacity and multi-sourcing constraints. Multimodal document understanding. RFPs, specs, quotes and contracts carry the actual requirements - and our T-LLM foundations already give us a head start there. Part of the work is choosing the right instrument for each - neural networks, gradient boosting, optimisation, bandits, mechanism design - instead of forcing one. This role performs communications system analyses, evaluates performance and interference considerations, and prepares technical documentation supporting system development, and licensing requirements. Using established engineering methods and regulatory guidelines, the Spectrum Engineer II resolves routine technical challenges and supports compliance with International Telecommunication Union (ITU) and Federal Communications Commission (FCC) requirements. Working cross-functionally with systems, software, RF, electrical, mechanical, integration and test, quality, regulatory, and program teams, this role supports communications systems engineering from concept development through integration, verification, and production while contributing to satellite licensing, regulatory filings, and spectrum coordination activities.

jobs.description_text: OPERATIONS The Operations team serves as the backbone of our marketplace, seamlessly managing the entire order journey. From creating online content and ensuring secure payments to order fulfillment and delivery, while providing comprehensive customer and partner care, this team is relentlessly focused on improving the customer experience every single day. PORTOOur office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. THE ROLE As an AI & Automation Engineer, you will act as both builder and strategic architect. You’ll partner with Product, Data and Operations to eliminate process bottlenecks and deploy production-grade systems that scale, helping evolve internal AI efforts into a centralized service capability. jobs.description_text: TECHNOLOGY The Technology team builds end-to-end products and solutions that power our marketplace, delivering an incredible experience for customers globally. From understanding customer and partner needs to designing and testing innovative hypotheses, we create industry-leading experiences for luxury customers everywhere. THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Data Scientist to join our Data team at FARFETCH, with a focus on evolving our in-house Experimentation Platform and its custom-built Statistical Engine. Our Experimentation Platform enables teams across FARFETCH to run A/B tests, measure the impact of product changes, and make data-driven decisions at scale. At its core, our Python-based Statistical Engine processes experiment results and powers automated, self-service analytics. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Statistical Engine, combining strong statistical expertise with software engineering skills to improve its reliability, scalability, and analytical capabilities. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Product, and Engineering teams to modernise our experimentation capabilities, introduce advanced statistical methods, and explore how AI can accelerate platform development and improve experimentation workflows.

The Lead BSA will be a core member within a cross-functional Pod that is delivers using hybrid-agile methodology and tools. The role is responsible for leading assigned integration workstreams, initiatives, and cross-functional deliverables while also providing governance, reporting, and program management support across the broader integration. The incumbent works with stakeholders across business and corporate functions to drive milestones, manage risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions, and help remove blockers that may impact program delivery. In addition, the role brings together information from across the program to produce executive materials, governance reporting, and actionable insights for leadership decision-making. jobs.title: Manager, Model Validation
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. Responsibilities include completing benchmark and outcome analyses, documenting issues and recommendations, drawing evidence-based conclusions, and preparing model validation reports in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

The role partners with business and functional leaders to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, challenge assumptions, assess performance drivers, and provide timely, decision-useful insight. It is accountable for the quality, consistency, governance, and continuous improvement of planning and forecasting processes and for establishing a high-performing Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence that scales common standards, tools, models, data, and insight across the Bank.

You will establish scalable processes, integrated planning practices, technology enablement, governance frameworks and operational discipline that help teams move faster, work smarter and deliver measurable business impact. You will build, lead and evolve a multidisciplinary function spanning marketing operations, automation, CRM/email operations and enablement. As a people leader, you will attract, develop and retain top talent, create clarity and accountability across the team, and foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and operational excellence. If you’re energized by building high-performing teams, driving transformation and enabling marketing through technology, automation and AI, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of marketing within a growing enterprise.

Reporting to the Manager, Executive Office & Board Liaison, you will act as an extension of both the executive and the Executive Office, exercising sound judgment, discretion, and independence in managing competing priorities, stakeholder relationships, and operational requirements. In addition to executive support responsibilities, you will contribute to the effectiveness of the Executive Office by supporting team initiatives, mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and helping drive consistency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the Executive Assistant function. As a senior member of the Executive Assistant function, this role serves as a trusted resource to the Executive Office and plays a key role in supporting operational excellence, consistency of service, team development, and the advancement of executive support practices across the organization. Key aspects of the role are governance, strategic initiatives, and managing key internal relationships enterprise-wide to champion risk and credit culture at the Bank.

The Senior Manager will lead the design, implementation, execution, and reporting of 1st line testing and risk management programs, ensuring regulatory compliance and operational excellence. This role supports both day-to-day business priorities and strategic initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to build and maintain a robust risk and control environment.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Lifecycle Management Strategy, is the owner of lifecycle strategy for the credit card portfolio. The role defines and executes integrated product, marketing and digital strategies across the cardholder journey to drive onboarding, activation, engagement, product usage, retention, loyalty and long-term customer engagement. Combining product knowledge, deep marketing expertise and business acumen, the Senior Manager translates customer insights, portfolio priorities and market opportunities into an actionable lifecycle roadmap. The role partners closely with Product, Digital, Marketing, Data and Analytics, Operations and Finance and teams to deliver coordinated customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. The successful candidate will possess a unique blend of marketing strategy, product, and analytical expertise, coupled with exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills. Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, they will lead the development of customer-centric engagement strategies, align stakeholders around shared business objectives, and identify innovative opportunities to strengthen customer relationships and accelerate portfolio growth.

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior ServiceNow Engineer will be a part of Equitable Bank’s ServiceNow Centre of Excellence. The primary responsibilities of this role will include designing, developing, and supporting ServiceNow applications, workflows, catalog items, integrations, and the platform in general. The Senior ServiceNow Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of major ServiceNow features and modules. This role operates with some degree of autonomy, owning feature-level solutions and driving technical excellence within the team. The Senior Engineer also mentors junior engineers and administrators and works collaboratively with all team members while enforcing best practices within the platform. The incumbent will also collaborate across teams to ensure robust, scalable, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions that align with business needs and regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (18 Month Contract)
jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) reports to the Director, Technical Program Management. The STPM owns end-to-end plan management and delivery execution for highly complex technical programs across EQ Bank's Digital Banking ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on measurable business value, customer outcomes, reliability, and usability. The STPM leads execution across multiple interdependent teams and domains, proactively surfaces technical and non-technical risks, establishes mitigation plans, manages complex dependencies, drives decisions, and enables alignment across Engineering, Product, Business, Enterprise partners, and third parties. The STPM applies company policies and Enterprise Change Management requirements while balancing governance with modern product and technology delivery practices. The STPM operates effectively where scope, ownership, or the delivery path is ambiguous. The role is expected to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence senior stakeholders without authority, resolve escalated delivery constraints, and provide clear executive-level visibility of program health, trade-offs, and decisions.

jobs.description_text: The Work This role leads the design, implementation, and operation of security controls for Artificial Intelligence (AI), generative AI, machine learning, AI agents, copilots, automation platforms, agentic AI platforms, orchestration frameworks, model providers, and the cloud services that support them. Reporting to the Senior Director, Cyber Security Engineering & Operations and working as a fully dedicated, embedded security partner to the AI Centre of Enablement and the Enterprise Technology, Data & AI organization, the incumbent provides senior technical leadership to ensure AI solutions are delivered securely and in line with enterprise security standards and regulatory expectations. The incumbent develops reusable security patterns, guardrails, control implementations, automation, and detection capabilities that support enterprise AI adoption while protecting the bank from data leakage, model misuse, insecure integrations, excessive permissions, unsafe automation, and unapproved use of AI technologies. The role enables teams through practical, reusable guardrails and secure patterns rather than relying only on review and enforcement.

The specialist will contribute to the development of policies, processes, and procedures for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) and provide expert advice on technology utilization to enhance overall enterprise value. In addition to these responsibilities, the position will focus on creating robust network architectures and developing high-level designs that meet business requirements. This includes designing network topologies, selecting appropriate technologies, and producing detailed documentation. The specialist will collaborate with various teams, including Azure Cloud Operations and business unit infrastructure requirements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives while supporting high-level infrastructure needs across the enterprise.

The IMO operates through a matrix of employees and consultants across the Bank, with the central programme office team and dedicated consultants reporting directly to the Vice President. This is a cross-bank role. The Integration Management Office is the connective tissue between the Executive Leadership Team, the executive sponsors who own each workstream's outcomes, the Board and its committees, the Bank's regulators, and the vendor providing transition services. The Vice President sets the cadence, the control structure and the reporting spine those audiences rely on, and converts complexity into decisions and execution plans. The role is deliberately broad rather than deep. jobs.description_text: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel – Technology & Trade Compliance
jobs.description_text: As Senior Legal Counsel – Technology & Trade Compliance, this isn’t your typical legal position. At Kepler, you’ll be embedded in a fast-moving team, helping to shape how we operate globally by balancing legal precision with bold innovation. You’ll provide hands-on legal expertise across a vast array of commercial agreements and government engagements, all while supporting cutting-edge space technology projects. As we push the boundaries of space-based connectivity, your work will ensure Kepler remains not only compliant but competitive in a highly regulated and technically complex landscape. Your decisions will directly influence how we launch, partner, build, and operate globally.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Program Manager at Kepler, you will spearhead the development and execution of mission-critical satellite systems from concept through on-orbit validation. You will drive strategic program initiatives that strengthen global partnerships and fuel our continued growth in the space sector. In this crucial role, you will lead a cross-functional team to develop and commission our Tranche-2 satellite constellation. You will serve as a key leader, working in close collaboration with our Engineering and Operations teams to ensure on-time, on-budget execution of programs from initial kickoff through operational handover. In addition to program execution, you may play a pivotal role in proposal efforts - contributing to opportunities involving the development or enhancement of satellite systems, software, satellite commissioning, or on-orbit operations. This role is ideally suited for candidates who bring good technical depth across a range of aerospace engineering disciplines paired with strong program management acumen. The successful candidate will have a proven ability to lead high-performing teams while building effective relationships with external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Spectrum Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Spectrum Engineer at Kepler, you will play a leading role in ensuring that our next-generation low-Earth orbit satellite communications systems are designed and operated in alignment with global spectrum regulations. You will integrate regulatory requirements, frequency-coordination considerations, and interference constraints into Kepler’s system architecture, analytical models, and resource-management capabilities. Working under Regulatory and supporting cross-functional teams such as the Systems Engineering, RF, Antenna, Mission Design, and Software teams, you will translate complex International Telecommunication Union (ITU) regulations into practical system requirements and technical solutions. You will lead critical analyses, influence system-level design decisions, and provide technical guidance on spectrum strategy, compliance, and performance optimization.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.
